title: 193. LFU Cache

examples.explanation: Capacity 2. get(1) returns 1; put(3,3) evicts key 2; get(2) returns -1 and get(3) returns 3. put(4,4) evicts key 1; get(1) returns -1 while get(3) returns 3 and get(4) returns 4.
Capacity 1. get(2) returns 1; put(3,2) evicts key 2; get(2) returns -1 and get(3) returns 2.
Capacity 2. put(1,9) updates key 1; get(1) returns 9 and get(2) returns -1.

hints: Keep key-to-value and key-to-frequency maps plus frequency-to-ordered-keys groups.
Track the minimum frequency; on eviction remove the least recently used key from the minimum group, and update min frequency after each get/put.
